name: Bipartite Graph Check
description: Determines if a graph can be 2-colored (bipartite) using BFS. A graph is bipartite if and only if it contains no odd-length cycles.
aim: Check if graph vertices can be split into two sets where all edges connect vertices from different sets. Uses BFS to 2-color the graph.
howItWorks: BFS: for each unvisited neighbor, assign opposite color
If a neighbor already has the same color as current: NOT bipartite
If all vertices 2-colored without conflict: graph IS bipartite

time.averageCase: BFS visits all vertices and edges

realWorld: Job scheduling: workers vs tasks (matching problems)
whenToUse: Check if graph has any odd cycle
